candidates.change_summary: Delete the require statement so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Replace the transfer call with selfdestruct to the recipient, changing the final balance.
Change the transfer recipient from _recipient to a different address (owner).
Change the transfer amount to zero instead of the full balance.
Insert a statement that sends 1 ether to the owner before the normal transfer, reducing the amount transferred.
Replace require owner check with require(false), making withdrawAll always revert.
Replace the transfer call with a send call that returns a boolean, changing the withdrawal semantics.
Remove the payable cast on the recipient, which will make the transfer compile differently but fail at runtime with non-payable addresses.
